text: Have you experienced any other unusual sensory perceptions, such as hearing voices or seeing things that others do not, during these past eight months? I also need to know if you have a personal or family history of psychiatric conditions like schizophrenia or bipolar disorder.

text: Have you experienced any depressive symptoms, such as persistent sadness, loss of interest, or changes in appetite and sleep patterns, during this period? text:
